effect.purpose: Read-only Effect v4 source pinned to the tag matching the effect catalog — the authority on what v4 actually exports, plus the v3→v4 migration notes and the @effect/vitest reference implementation. Vendored from the main Effect-TS/effect monorepo since 2026-07-19; v4 development moved back there when the effect-smol repo was archived. Vendored here as .repos/effect (renamed from .repos/effect-smol on 2026-08-11 — the upstream name was confusing agents).

orientation.layout: Sparse checkout: packages/effect (core source + package.json exports map), packages/vitest (@effect/vitest reference implementation), migration/ (per-domain v3→v4 notes), ai-docs/, LLMS.md, MIGRATION.md.
orientation.startHere:
packages/effect/src settles what v4 actually exports (evidence-ladder rung 2); migration/*.md settles v3→v4 renames (rung 1). Before trusting an answer, check the pin matches the installed effect version — node_modules wins on disagreement.

Services/tags live in Context.ts — there is no ServiceMap.ts (re-verified at beta.107; agents coming from other Effect lines reliably look for the wrong filename). Key consumer-side fact settled there: Context.Key<Id, Shape> extends Effect<Shape, never, Id> (Context.ts:64) — v4 tags/Service classes are still first-class Effects, flatMap-able without .asEffect().

vitest.purpose: Read-only Vitest v5 source pinned to the v5.0.0 tag — the authority on the reporter/runner/benchmark/report APIs the vitest-agent family builds against, plus the official docs (migration guide, benchmarking, reporters). Vendored 2026-09-06 for the Vitest 4→5 migration research.
